name: crixin-voice
description: Give your AI a real phone — place calls, send SMS, fetch recordings and transcripts.
long_description: Crixin Voice lets Claude place real phone calls and send SMS on your behalf. Use it hosted with a Crixin key (unlimited calls, one monthly fee — no telecom account needed), or bring your own Twilio credentials and run everything locally. Six tools: make_call, get_call, list_calls, list_recordings, transcribe_call, send_sms. Calls to the US, UK, EU, Australia and New Zealand require you to attest prior consent; the extension refuses to dial otherwise.

tools.name: make_call
tools.description: Place an outbound phone call and optionally record the reply.

tools.name: get_call
tools.description: Look up a call's status, duration and price by SID.

tools.name: list_calls
tools.description: List recent calls with optional filters.

tools.name: list_recordings
tools.description: List recordings attached to a call.

crixin_api_key.title: Crixin API key
crixin_api_key.description: crx_live_… key from the Crixin dashboard. Hosted mode: no Twilio account needed. Leave blank to use your own Twilio credentials below.

twilio_phone_number.title: Twilio caller number
twilio_phone_number.description: E.164, e.g. +15551234567. Only for bring-your-own-Twilio mode.

deepgram_api_key.title: Deepgram API key
deepgram_api_key.description: Optional. Enables transcribe_call in bring-your-own-Twilio mode.
